name: images_models_list
description: TTI model catalog, lean. `search` filters by name, slug, family (gpt, seedream, flux…), description, or tags. Set `includePreviews` only when the caller needs model preview images.

includePreviews.description: When true, include the model preview image URL. Omit for a smaller catalog.

onlyRecommended.description: When true, returns only models with an `agentRecommendation`.
